Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.ott

package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.ott
Use cases of the one-time-code (e-mail and SMS) authentication factor: requesting, verifying and cleaning up codes, and the policy beans they share.
  • Class
    Description
    CleanupOttUseCase
    Deletes what the one-time-code and SMS features leave behind: expired codes, expired pending phone verifications, cost ledger rows older than the retention and expired magic-link tokens.
    DeliverOneTimeTokenUseCase
    Delivers what the one-time token use cases asked for: an e-mailed code or link, or a text message whose cost was already recorded.
    EmailCodeRequested
    Event published when a one-time code must be e-mailed.
    EmailLinkRequested
    Event published when a magic link must be e-mailed.
    OneTimeCodeRequestResult
    Outcome of a request for a one-time code.
    OttCleanupResult
    Number of rows removed by a cleanup run.
    OttConfiguration
    Declares the collaborators of the one-time-code use cases as beans, so they can be replaced and mocked.
    OttDestination
    Where a one-time code of a user is delivered.
    OttProperties
    Settings of the one-time codes, bound from authserver.ott.* once and validated at startup.
    OttVerificationResult
    Outcome of the verification of a one-time code.
    OttVerificationResult.Status
    What happened when a code was verified.
    RequestMagicLinkUseCase
    Sends a magic link to the verified e-mail address of an enabled account.
    RequestOneTimeCodeUseCase
    Sends a one-time code to a user, by e-mail or SMS.
    ResolveOttDestinationUseCase
    Finds where a one-time code of a user may be delivered: the verified e-mail address or the verified phone of an enabled account.
    SecureRandomOneTimeCodeGenerator
    Generates numeric one-time codes with a cryptographically strong random number generator.
    Sha256OneTimeCodeHasher
    Hashes one-time codes with SHA-256 (lower-case hex) and compares them in constant time.
    VerifyOneTimeCodeUseCase
    Verifies a one-time code.
